objective: Design a bounded patch-only development harness with distinct worker, trusted validation, sandboxed test and human-controlled acceptance boundaries, including adversarial test specifications and rollout decisions.
request_basis: User requested proceeding after the proposal to design patch-only operation and permission boundaries first, because coding agents may ignore Markdown instructions. This scope is documentation and verification of that design, not OS configuration or implementation of a patch applier.
acceptance: Clearly distinguish current voluntary CLI checks from proposed enforcement; no 100-percent compliance, authenticated approval, active sandbox or product GO claims.
Specify minimum-authority worker inputs/outputs, separate immutable policy/checker baselines and sandboxed candidate tests; no execution of patch/source instructions by a privileged controller.

Bound the first candidate change format and define strict paths, bytes, operations, scope, snapshot binding, reviewer evidence, cancellation/replay and check-then-accept failure handling; preserve dirty user work and distinguish acceptance from checkout mutation and rollback.
Provide uniquely identified positive/negative scenarios with expected evidence and honest NOT RUN status, plus checkpoint owners, budget limits and unresolved environment choices.

Preserve all preexisting edits, runtime/source/data, core harness/journal/checkers and plan/state; no install, model call, sandbox/ACL/hook setup, promotion/ref write, historical generation or automatic follow-up task.
